bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; modifying the professions that may serve as a medical consultant for a community health board; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 145A.02, subdivision 15.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 145A.02, subdivision 15, is amended to read:

Subd. 15.
Medical consultant.
"Medical consultant" means [+an individual who: +]
[+(1) is licensed in Minnesota by the Board of Medical Practice as +]a physician [-licensed to practice medicine in Minnesota who-][+, doctor of osteopathic medicine, or physician assistant or is licensed in Minnesota by the Board of Nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse and is certified to practice as a clinical nurse specialist or nurse practitioner by a national nurse certification organization acceptable to the board; and +]
[+(2)+] is working under a written agreement with, employed by, or on contract with a community health board to provide advice and information, to authorize medical procedures through protocols, and to assist a community health board and its staff in coordinating their activities with local medical practitioners and health care institutions.
